locator: Spotlight on Resources -- 2026 Edition; Why are resources important?
facts: SSI countable resources must not exceed $2,000 for an individual or $3,000 for a couple.
The page distinguishes countable resources from items that do not count, including the home a person lives in and generally one vehicle used for transportation.
